_comment: Hand-authored glosses. Authoritative — build_lexicon prefers these over kaikki.
`reviewed: true` means a native speaker signed off. Everything else is a DRAFT
and carries review_status needs_review, per the START-HERE guardrail that
machine/model-generated text is never shipped as the answer.
Romanian band-1 glosses below were drafted by the build assistant, not a native.

chlap.notes: 'tip' is colloquial RO; 'bărbat' is neutral. Which one leads is a register call.

en: to miss (chýbaš mi = I miss you)
ro: chýbaš mi = mi-e dor de tine
a merge bine (darí sa mi = îmi merge bine)

en: Čo sa deje? = What's going on?

fajn.notes: colloquial, borrowed from German 'fein'. RO 'fain' is a genuine cognate-feel match.

hej.notes: colloquial yes. §11.2 measured áno rank 32 / hej rank 58 — teach as equals, hej informal.

kurva.notes: vulgar (register_flag). Gloss kept for recognition only; excluded from lessons.

en: to be sorry (mrzí ma = I'm sorry about)
let (nech sa páči = here you are)
not to go (artefact — negation of ísť)

nuž.notes: same family as `no`, slightly more old-fashioned/narrative. Register call.

ok.notes: anglicism, extremely common in speech. Kept as-is.

en: to succeed (podarilo sa mi = I managed)
to move (pf., colloq. variant of pohnúť)
to take care of (postarať sa o)
to please (páči sa mi = I like it)
páčiť.notes: `páči sa mi` = 'îmi place' — dative experiencer in BOTH languages (§11.9). Worth a grammar note.

rád.notes: not an adjective in the usual sense — `rád + verb` = 'îmi place să'. Agrees: rád/rada/radi.

stať.notes: almost always reflexive: `stať sa` = a deveni / a se întâmpla.

ro: tešiť sa na = a aștepta cu nerăbdare

en: vydať sa = to get married (of a woman)

však.notes: tag question / 'totuși'. Two quite different uses; a native should split them.

en: to seem (zdá sa mi = it seems to me)
